sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the Arena, see Arena BattlePass.

The BattlePass is a system in Escape from Tarkov that allows players to progress through tiers and unlock rewards. It is available in all game modes, progression and rewards are shared between them.

sections.heading: Season 1 - "KORD BREACH"
sections.text: The BattlePass for Season 1 started on August 3, 2026 and ends on December 7, 2026. It contains 53 free levels.

sections.heading: Progression
sections.text:
To progress through this BattlePass, TerraGroup documentation needs to be found during raids. Unlocking each BattlePass reward requires turning in a specific type of documentation. This type of loot functions similarly to task items, meaning every player can pick it up, even if someone else has already done so. These items can be found while playing as either a PMC or a Scav in every game mode. Documentation comes in several different types, each tied to specific locations:
- Blueprints and technical documentation — Interchange, Factory, The Labyrinth
- Financial documents — Customs, Streets of Tarkov, Interchange
- Medical documents — The Lab, Ground Zero, The Labyrinth
- PMC personnel files — Reserve, Lighthouse, Icebreaker
- User documentation — Ground Zero, Streets of Tarkov, The Lab
- Test documentation — Shoreline, Woods, Icebreaker
- Technical documentation — Shoreline, Woods, Lighthouse
- Project documentation — Factory, Reserve, Customs

There are also Classified documents which can be bought in the Expansion Hub and used in place of any other documentation type. They are also valid for future BattlePasses.

It is also possible to exchange any 5 documentation for 1 documentation of choice.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text:
Up to 30 documents can be found each day before they reset. You can locate the amount of documents still available to collect on the BattlePass screen under the documents section on the right hand side. If you collect 15 documents in the PvE game mode and then switch to the seasonal game mode, you may only collect 15 documents until you reach your limit for the day.

The daily limits are:
- Seasonal game mode: 30 documents
- PvP game mode: 20 documents
- PvE game mode: 15 documents

sections.heading: Rewards
